status: freeze-candidate, NOT frozen (research run blocked in code until the freeze hash is set)
question: Does the identity of an original stimulus A/B stay readable when class-independent distractor pulses occur in the pause, and how do a modular and an equal-budget uniform network differ?

window.position: steps d-2 .. d, directly before the readout x_(d+1)

tasks.preserve: target class s in {A, B} from y; equal priors
tasks.update: channel of the LAST pulse in the window (X/Y) from the same y; patterns without pulse excluded (mass 1/8); conditional on >= 1 pulse the classes X/Y have equal prior; K0: not applicable (N/A, no value)

level_B.definition: acc_B = E_y[max_c P(c|y)], y from the equal-prior mixture of the class-conditional finite Gaussian mixtures
level_B.preserve_likelihood: p(y|s) = sum_pi P(pi) N(y; z(s,pi), sigma^2 I)
level_B.update_likelihood: p(y|L=l) = sum_s 1/2 sum_{pi: last(pi)=l} P(pi)/P(last=l) N(y; z(s,pi), sigma^2 I)
level_B.K0_preserve: analytic Phi(||z(A)-z(B)|| / 2 sigma), no Monte Carlo
level_B.states: z(s,pi) = x_(d+1) from the tested kernel (2 x 27 deterministic runs per network/condition/delay)

streams.names: (task, network, nonlinearity, condition, delay); one independent stream per estimate

numerics: squared distances from centred coordinates, clipped at 0
blockwise mean and M2 merged with Chan's formula; SE = sqrt(var/n)

error_sources.approximation: normal approximation of the MC mean in z tests and intervals
error_sources.rounding: floating point; not part of SE

level_D.role: descriptive only (O11): how much a trained decoder reads out; does not confirm or refute level-B statements
decoders: lda_ledoit_wolf (pooled within-class covariance, Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage to scaled identity, training data only, threshold at the midpoint)

streams.names: (seed, kind in {pattern, noise}, role in {decoder_train, test}, delay); identical across networks, nonlinearities and conditions (paired), disjoint across roles

level_D.pairing: within a split each pattern is used for one A and one B episode; across networks/conditions same patterns and noise per seed; the decoder sees only y

A1.what: x_B(k) = P x_A(k) for all k and patterns, P-fixed sites
applies: F and Fplus in both networks
A1.negative_control: N in the modular network (must NOT hold)

A2_structural.what: ||P_- r(pi)|| <= tol for all patterns, linear twins, P-fixed sites

A2_numeric.what: |acc_B(cond) - acc_B(K0)| <= 4 SE, linear twins, P-fixed sites

A3_numeric.what: acc_B(cond) <= acc_B(K0) + 4 SE, linear twins, all conditions

diagnostics.alarm_policy: A 4-SE exceedance is a STATISTICAL DIAGNOSTIC ALARM, not a proof of a programming error: it can occur by chance with a correct computation. Number of numeric checks fixed: A2_numeric 15 (5 per delay x 3), A3_numeric 18 (6 per delay x 3); expected chance alarms about 0.0015 in total. An alarm is reported with its value; it may trigger an investigation that is reported separately (e.g. one diagnostic re-computation with an independent, pre-named stream 'diagnostic-rerun'), but the original result stays the reported result. No repetition until a check passes. A1 and A2_structural are deterministic (floating-point tolerances), a violation there is reported as a failed check.

confirmatory.delta_note: pre-chosen practical minimum difference for this model, not a general relevance threshold (O9)
confirmatory.statistic: Z = (Delta_hat - delta) / SE(Delta_hat), SE = sqrt(SE_1^2 + SE_2^2) from independent MC streams (K0 terms analytic); p = 1 - Phi(Z)
confirmatory.se_zero_rule: if SE(Delta_hat) = 0: p = 0 if Delta_hat > delta else 1

holm.rule: order p; reject H(1) if p(1) <= 0.025; only then reject H(2) if p(2) <= 0.05

report: unadjusted two-sided 95% MC intervals, named as unadjusted

wording.contrary: Richtung widerspricht der Hypothese, only if the unadjusted 95% interval lies entirely below 0

confirmatory.uncertainty_meaning: Monte Carlo uncertainty about a deterministic quantity of the fixed model; no population of networks or seeds
confirmatory.release: only for a complete research run with the frozen protocol (hash match), all streams and seeds present, no failures

descriptive: H-F: |I_n(F)| in both tanh networks (no TOST)
level D for both tasks and both decoders: paired seed differences, 95% bootstrap over whole seeds, labelled unadjusted
update task and any trade-off between preserving and updating
exclusion: a failure in any sub-run (seed or MC stream) is logged; the run is then incomplete and nothing is confirmed
update task: patterns/episodes without pulse are excluded; their number/mass is reported
non-finite values abort with status, no silent repair
no change of conditions, delays, decoders, n_mc, delta or alpha after the freeze

resources.runtime_check: measured at development settings before the freeze (ROADMAP M10d)

smoke.purpose: after the freeze: runtime and format only

development.purpose: tests, tool checks and the runtime check; values chosen outside the research conditions
